title: ML Engineer
summary: Train, ship and run models in production, and prepare for ML engineering interviews. Start after Foundations.

stages.title: Deep Learning
stages.passCriteria: You can train an image or text model in PyTorch, explain each step, and explain how attention works.

stages.title: Deployment & MLOps
stages.passCriteria: You can deploy a model, track experiments and monitor it in production.

stages.title: ML System Design
stages.passCriteria: You can design an ML system end to end and explain its trade-offs.

stages.title: Portfolio Project
stages.passCriteria: You can take one model from raw data to a deployed, tested service, show where it fails, and explain your trade-offs.

stages.title: Interview Prep
stages.passCriteria: You can solve timed coding problems on data structures and algorithms, and answer ML knowledge and system design questions under time pressure. You have 3–5 STAR stories ready that show what you did on a team, the result in numbers, and what you learned.
